summary: Frontend-only E2E of the new CRM Tenders guided wizard (default) + quick-form escape. All 3 flows verified end-to-end via the production public URL as master admin: (1) Guided wizard with method 'later' — Basics→Customer→Questions→AI help→Review, Next disabled until title present, Back navigation works, Create POSTs to /api/crm/v2/tenders (200) and opens the full tender editor (tabs Overview/Timeline/Questions/Documents/Strategy) for the new tender. (2) Quick-form escape via tender-wizard-mode-toggle renders the original quick create form, submitting it creates the tender (POST 200) and opens the editor. (3) AI extraction path via paste — after Create, POST /api/crm/v2/tenders/{id}/ai/parse returned 200 and the editor showed Questions (3), confirming parsed questions were persisted. No console errors relevant to the flow (only benign CSP notices from third-party analytics blocked by CSP, unrelated to this feature).
critical_code_review_comments: CRMTenders.js is 2272 lines — long-standing size issue; consider splitting TenderList / TenderDetail / analytics into separate files (not blocking).
finishWizard swallows upload/parse errors with generic toasts (acceptable graceful behavior per spec).
seed_data_creation: Created 3 QA tenders in Pulse Fitness org: 'QA Guided Tender ...', 'QA Quick Tender ...', 'QA Paste Tender ...' — safe to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guided tender wizard flow is fully green. testids used: create-tender-btn, create-tender-dialog, tender-create-wizard, tender-wizard-steps, tender-wiz-step-1..5, tender-wiz-title, tender-wiz-next, tender-wiz-back, tender-wiz-create, tender-wiz-qmethod-upload/-paste/-later, tender-wiz-file-input, tender-wiz-paste, tender-wizard-mode-toggle. Quick-form Create Tender button has no data-testid — tests find it via text 'Create Tender' inside create-tender-dialog (works, but adding data-testid="tender-quick-create-btn" would harden regression).
